perfume.answer: Air France allows perfume, eau de Cologne, hair spray and deodorant in the cabin and in the hold, up to 0.5 kg or 500 ml per article and 2 kg or 2 l per person, on top of the cabin liquid restrictions.

sections.h: 🧴 What Air France says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Air France page "Aérosols, articles de toilette et médicaments" (in French), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Air France rule
rows: Hair spray, deodorant, perfume, eau de Cologne, nail polish remover, nail polish, and medicines containing alcohol
2 kg or 2 l net for toiletries, non-radioactive medicines and the aerosols listed
No more than 0.5 kg or 500 ml net
These quantities do not replace the separate cabin liquid restrictions
You can buy these items in airport duty-free shops after security
Not in the cabin; allowed in the hold; valve must have a cap
Flammable or toxic aerosols (paints, varnish, acetone, lighter fluid)
Not in the cabin and not in the hold

list: Not on the page: the page does not name a limit for single perfume bottles in the cabin beyond referring to the cabin liquid restrictions.

faq: Can I take perfume in my Air France cabin bag?
Yes, within 0.5 kg or 500 ml per article and 2 kg or 2 l in total per person, and the cabin liquid restrictions still apply.
Can I pack hair spray or deodorant in my Air France checked bag?
Yes. Toiletries and aerosols of this kind are allowed in the hold within the same quantity limits.
